---
title: "Media Viewer Tool Strip"
format: html
---

## Overview

The Media Viewer includes a vertical tool strip along the left edge of the widget, to the left of the vertical pixel ruler. It follows an Inkscape/Photoshop-style layout where tools are square icon buttons with exclusive selection.

## Layout

The `Media_Widget` grid places the tool strip in column 0 spanning three rows:

| Col 0 | Col 1 | Col 2 |
|-------|-------|-------|
| Tool strip (row span 3) | Tool options bar (col span 2) | |
| | Ruler corner | Horizontal ruler |
| | Vertical ruler | Graphics view |

See [Media Viewer Tool Options Bar](MediaToolOptionsBar.qmd) for contextual controls above the horizontal ruler.

## Components

| Component | Location | Role |
|-----------|----------|------|
| `MediaToolStrip_Widget` | `Media_Widget/UI/Tools` | Vertical toolbar with exclusive `QButtonGroup` |
| `MediaToolId` | `Media_Widget/UI/Tools` | Tool identifiers (`None`, `Select`, `Pen`, `Eraser`, `Smooth`) |
| `Media_KeymapActions` | `Media_Widget/Core` | Keymap dispatch for tool switching and pen options |
| `MediaToolIcons` | `Media_Widget/UI/Tools` | Programmatic placeholder icons |

## Selection API

- `activeTool()` returns the current `MediaToolId` (`None`, `Select`, `Pen`, or `Eraser`)
- `setActiveTool(MediaToolId)` updates the checked button (or unchecks all for `None`)
- `activeToolChanged(MediaToolId)` is emitted when the user selects or deactivates a tool
- Clicking the active tool button again sets `MediaToolId::None`

`Media_Widget` wires `activeMediaTool` in state; `MediaSelectToolController` enables unified canvas selection only when `Select` is active. The **Pen** tool routes Ctrl+click / Alt+click line edits through `MediaLine_Widget`. The **Eraser** tool removes line vertices or mask pixels under the hover circle via `MediaLine_Widget` and `MediaMask_Widget`.

## Keyboard Shortcuts

Tool switching is registered in `MediaWidgetRegistration.cpp` and dispatched through `handleMediaKeyAction()` in `Media_KeymapActions.cpp` via the `Media_Window` `KeyActionAdapter`. Default bindings (Inkscape-style):

| Action ID | Default Key |
|-----------|-------------|
| `media.tool.select` | S |
| `media.tool.pen` | P |
| `media.tool.eraser` | E |
| `media.tool.smooth` | Shift+S |
| `media.tool.none` | Escape |
| `media.pen.cycle_append_endpoint` | X (Pen tool active only) |

Keyboard tool keys always activate the named tool. **Escape** deselects the active tool (equivalent to clicking the active toolbar button again). See [Media Keymap Actions](../../Media_Widget/Core/Media_KeymapActions.qmd).

## Adding Tools

1. Add a value to `MediaToolId`
2. Provide an icon (programmatic helper or resource file)
3. Register the button in `MediaToolStrip_Widget`'s constructor via `_addToolButton()`
